sections.instruction: [This form is divided into three sections. Section 1 is intended for use by the individual submitting the change request. Section 2 is intended for use by the Project Manager to document/communicate their initial impact analysis of the requested change. Section 3 is intended for use by the Change Control Board (CCB) to document their final decision regarding the requested change.] [CR001] [John Doe] [Enter a detailed description of the change being requested] [mm/dd/yyyy] [mm/dd/yyyy] [Enter a detailed description of why the change is being requested] [List other artifacts affected by this change] [Document assumptions or comments regarding the requested change] [Enter additional comments] [Approval Signature] [mm/dd/yyyy] [#hrs] [Enter the hour impact of the requested change] [#dys] [Enter the duration impact of the requested change] [WBS] [Detail the impact this change may have on schedules] [Cost] [Detail the impact this change may have on cost] [Enter additional comments] [Enter recommendations regarding the requested change] [Approval Signature] [mm/dd/yyyy] [mm/dd/yyyy] [Document the CCB’s decision] [Document and conditions imposed by the CCB] [Approval Signature] [mm/dd/yyyy]
